$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.grammar.haxe.types. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-FNTYPE-NEST-TYPE-ARG-OFF
arms.note: a type argument is no longer marked nested, so a function type inside `Array<…>` or `Null<…>` loses the additional unit and continues one unit past its line

arms.name: M-FNTYPE-NEST-PARENS-OFF
arms.note: a parenthesised function type is no longer marked nested, so it continues one unit past its line instead of two

arms.name: M-FNTYPE-NEST-COND-OFF
arms.note: a function type inside a `#if` type arm is no longer marked nested, so it continues one unit past its line instead of two

arms.name: M-INTERSECTION-OPERAND-NOT-TYPEDEF-BODY
arms.note: an intersection operand of a typedef body is an ordinary anon type, so a Next left curly no longer lays it out one field per line

arms.name: M-ARROW-TYPE-IN-TYPEDEF-BODY
arms.note: an anon parameter or return of an old-style function type under a typedef counts as the typedef body, so a Next left curly lays it out one field per line

arms.name: M-ARROW-FN-TYPE-IN-TYPEDEF-BODY
arms.note: an anon parameter of a `(args) -> ret` function type under a typedef counts as the typedef body, so a Next left curly lays it out one field per line

arms.name: M-TYPEPARAM-META-UNDECLARED
arms.note: a type parameter declares no metadata run, so `<@:const N>` and `<T:Foo = Bar, @:const N>` stop parsing

arms.name: M-TYPEPARAM-CONSTRAINT-AFTER-LEAD-OFF
arms.note: the constraint has no AfterLead slot, so a comment after its colon is dropped and the writer round trip refuses the file

arms.name: M-TYPEPARAM-DEFAULT-AFTER-LEAD-OFF
arms.note: the default has no AfterLead slot, so a comment after its `=` is dropped and the writer round trip refuses the file
